text:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Alert: Elevated 5xx and gateway timeouts observed across us-west edge pool (spike started ~4387654300). Auto-pager sent to #incidents.
Sara (oncall): I'm on it. seeing 502/504 bursts on /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings.
Kai (sre): Confirmed. Grafana dashboard shows 12% error rate spike, p95 latency up from 180ms -> 1.2s.
Maya (eng-runtime): Any recent deploys to edge-proxy? I see a canary for edge-proxy v2.3.1 finished 4387654200.
Ravi (backend): Noted. No config change on backend. Could be header propagation.
Tom (observability): We're missing spans for a subset of requests — traces stop at ingress, no downstream spans. Sampling unchanged.
Jen (support): We have 3 customers reporting 502s for batch embeddings. Tix #12345, #12346.
Sara (oncall): Action list: 1) Triage ingress proxy health 2) Add stopgap tracing forwarder 3) Route around impacted AZ if needed.
Kai (sre): Running quick checks: `kubectl get pods -n redwood-ingress -l app=edge-proxy` shows 3/5 pods Ready. One OOMKilled earlier. Logs show repeated `ERR: missing trace header` messages.
Maya (eng-runtime): Edge-proxy change in v2.3.1 introduced a new header `x-rdl-trace` rename; that could drop upstream OTEL propagation. Rolling back would be safest but need quick mitigation.
Tom (observability): Because traces are being lost at ingress we should enable ephemeral OTEL collector sidecar on ingress pods to capture whatever headers exist. I'll push a hotpatch to deploy a collector as a DaemonSet with low retention.
Ravi (backend): Can we hotpatch proxy to re-insert `traceparent` when `x-rdl-trace` present? Quick lua filter maybe?
Maya (eng-runtime): Yes. I can patch the lua filter:```\n# lua snippet\nlocal hdr = ngx.var.http_x_rdl_trace\nif hdr and not ngx.var.http_traceparent then\n  ngx.req.set_header("traceparent", hdr)\nend\n```
Maya (eng-runtime): Pushing patch to canary first. Deploy command: `kubectl apply -f ingress-lua-fix.yaml -n redwood-ingress`
Kai (sre): Meanwhile I'm scaling ingress replicas to 8 and bumping pod-memory to avoid OOMs. `kubectl scale --replicas=8 deploy/edge-proxy -n redwood-ingress`
IncidentBot: Pager: on-call Sara acknowledged. Escalation to SRE after 10m if no progress.
Jen (support): Notifying impacted customers that we're investigating; we'll update every 30m.
Tom (observability): Quick logging patch: enable structured debug logs for ingress and forward to ephemeral log-aggregator. Add `RDW_TRACE_HINT` tag to logs so we can correlate missing spans.
Sara (oncall): Can someone enable temporary higher trace sampling for ingress? We need more coverage to confirm propagation after the patch.
Tom (observability): Doing it now: updating `OTEL_SAMPLER_PROBABILITY=0.5` via `kubectl set env deploy/edge-proxy -n redwood-ingress OTEL_SAMPLER_PROBABILITY=0.5`
Ravi (backend): Applying lua patch to canary pod now. If it looks OK I'll roll to stable.
Maya (eng-runtime): Canary logs: traceparent reinserted, downstream services starting to show spans. Early signs positive.
Kai (sre): Error rate dropping to 6% in canary region. Routing shift: `traffic-controller set-route --exclude-zone us-west-2b` to reduce load on impacted AZ.
Sara (oncall): Good. Keep rollback plan ready if regressions. Who's owning rollback?
Maya (eng-runtime): I will if we see new errors. Rollback command: `kubectl rollout undo deploy/edge-proxy -n redwood-ingress`
Tom (observability): Note: we still have a gap — older ingress pods still emitting unstructured logs. I'm deploying a small forwarding sidecar that tails `/var/log/ingress/*.log` and tags entries with pod metadata. This will give us correlation until full rollout.
Jen (support): Customer comms: sent interim update: "We're mitigating an edge routing issue causing increased 5xxs; workaround and monitoring in progress. Next update 30m."
Kai (sre): After patches, p95 latency back to 250ms for canary; global error rate trending down to 2.8%.
Ravi (backend): Backend health checks OK. No increased CPU. Looks like header loss was the root cause.
Sara (oncall): Checklist before declaring resolved: - Confirm global error rate <1% - Confirm traces now present end-to-end for sampled requests - Revert debug/sampling changes - Postmortem owner assigned
Maya (eng-runtime): I'll hold off reverting until we have 30m stable. Also I'll bake a unit test for header mapping and include in CI.
Tom (observability): Postmortem note: Observability gap was that ingress dropped renaming of trace header in a minor release; we lacked automated contract checks for header passthrough. Adding that to action items.
Kai (sre): I'll scale down debug sampling back to 0.01 once verified: `kubectl set env deploy/edge-proxy -n redwood-ingress OTEL_SAMPLER_PROBABILITY=0.01`
IncidentBot: Incident state: mitigated -> monitoring. Pager will close if stable for 30m.
Sara (oncall): Thanks all. Tom please own instrumentation follow-up, Maya own rollback guard and test, Kai own capacity runbook update, Ravi help validate integration tests.
Tom (observability): Acknowledged. I'll open the postmortem draft and include trace header contract + quick instrumentation runbook.
Jen (support): I'll close customer loop with a write-up once postmortem ready.
Sara (oncall): Final check: error rate at 0.9% and tracing appears intact in sampled traces. Marking as resolved in 20m if stable. :white_check_mark:
Maya (eng-runtime): Canary patch rolled to stable at 4387654695. No regressions observed.
Kai (sre): Scaling revert complete, OTEL sampling back to baseline at 4387654730.
IncidentBot: Incident resolved. Summary: ingress header rename in v2.3.1 caused trace loss and 5xx spike; hotpatch reinserted traceparent, temporary OTEL collector & log forwarder added, traffic shifted away from affected AZ, customers notified. Postmortem action items assigned."
